caseNameFull: Dong Wing Ott v. Shaughnessy, District Director, Immigration and Naturalization Service
attorneys: Elmer Fried was on the motion for petitioners.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit. The motion to substitute John L. Murff as party respondent in the place and stead of Edward J. Shaughnessy, retired, is granted.
